have / have got 的用法: 表达"拥有"可用 have 或 have got;英式口语爱用 have got,疑问否定借 got 或助动词 do。

肯定:I have a car. = I have got a car. = I've got a car.|疑问:Do you have...? / Have you got...?|否定:I don't have... / I haven't got...|have 表动作(吃饭/上课)时不能用 got:have lunch|have to 表必须(呼应情态动词)|美式多用 do/does 构成疑问否定
Have you got a pen I can borrow?
We have lunch at twelve every day.
column3: 我们每天十二点吃午饭。

column4: Have you got...? 是英式疑问式。

# title: He ___ have a bike, so he walks to school.
column4: 美式否定 doesn't have;hasn't 后缺 got 不成立。
表动作"吃晚饭"用 have,不能加 got。

# title: She ___ a beautiful garden behind her house.
column4: 第三人称单数 has got 表拥有。

# title: ___ your brother have a driving licence?
column4: 美式疑问用 Does + 动词原形 have。

# title: I ___ any money with me today.
column4: 否定"没有"用 don't have(any 提示否定)。
